column1: # Graded judgments over the documentation site's pages (ADR-0100 D3).
# kind <TAB> query <TAB> page=grade ...   grades: 3 the page that answers it, 2 substantially
# about it, 1 mentions it usefully; a page not listed is 0. Pages are paths under content/
# without `.md`. One assessor, graded from each page's title, summary and section headings —
# a limit worth stating: a second assessor would disagree on some 1s and 2s.
# `word` queries are what a reader types and finishes; `prefix` the word they are part-way
# through; `fuzzy` a word typed wrongly. Four fuzzy queries carry two adjacent transpositions
# (`trasnactoin`, `subscirptoin`, `replciatoin`) or a typo inside the exact leading run
# (`anlayzer`), so a change to how transpositions are counted or to that run shows here.
